title: Width of a constructed CNF
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $c_1,\ldots,c_r$ be a list of clauses on $n$ variables. The width of the CNF formula formed from this list equals the maximum clause width in the list, with width $0$ when the list is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A list of clauses on $n$ variables is given
